sentimento.text1: In the Polymarket winner contract, Flávio Bolsonaro stands at 61.05% (vol USD 12.79M cumulative) and Lula at 37.50% (vol USD 13.00M cumulative), confirmed reading of 01/Oct, 19:29 BRT. Against the confirmed reading of 29/Sep at 11:58 BRT, Flávio Bolsonaro rises 1.25pp and Lula falls 2.00pp, and since the pair's sum fell from 99.30 to 98.55 the normalized move is 1.73pp for each side. The gap over Lula widens from 20.30pp to 23.55pp, the fifth straight widening between confirmed readings, after 13.65pp on 26/Sep, 14.75pp on 27/Sep, 16.55pp on 28/Sep and 20.30pp on 29/Sep. In the points recorded on 01/Oct Flávio Bolsonaro's price ranged from 61.05% to 63.30%, and that 63.30% is the high of the series recorded since April 14.
sentimento.text2: 🗳️ TWO NATIONAL POLLS CAME OUT ON 01/Oct: Datafolha (BR-08039/2026, n=2,506, fieldwork from 28/Sep to 01/Oct) gives Lula 42% to 38% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and 48% to 45% in the second, and Real Time Big Data (BR-09503/2026, n=2,000, fieldwork from 26 to 30/Sep) gives Lula 43% to 39% in the first and Flávio Bolsonaro 46% to 45% in the second. On 30/Sep came Futura/100% Cidades (BR-01122/2026, n=2,000), with Flávio Bolsonaro 42.2% to 39.4% in the first round and 49% to 43.5% in the second, Ideia for Canal Meio (BR-08706/2026, n=2,000), with Lula 39.4% to 38.4% and 48.5% to 48%, and Indexa for Broadcast (BR-00698/2026, n=2,000), with Lula 39% to 34% and 43% to 42%. In the five national polls released on 30/Sep and 01/Oct, Lula leads the first round in four (Datafolha, Real Time Big Data, Indexa and Ideia) and trails in one (Futura), and in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) he leads in three (Datafolha, Indexa and Ideia) and trails in two (Real Time Big Data and Futura). ⚖️ In the second round, four of the five fall within the poll's own margin; only Futura, with 5.5 points for Flávio Bolsonaro, falls outside it. 🏷️ On the night of 30/Sep Veritá released the consolidation of 27 state polls, with 40.5 thousand interviews from 20 to 25/Sep, in valid votes only: Flávio Bolsonaro 45.14% and Lula 44.65%. It does not enter the panel's poll chart because it measures valid votes, not total voting intention, and because each state has its own [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registration, with no single national registration. The presidential book received USD 2.47M in new money since 29/Sep and totals USD 159.29M cumulative across 19 contracts.
sentimento.text3: 🥉 IN THE THIRD-PLACE BOOK OF THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) RENAN SANTOS STAYS AHEAD, BUT THE DISTANCE NARROWS: he falls 3.00pp, to 48.50% (vol USD 0.52M cumulative), and Augusto Cury rises 0.85pp, to 36.70% (vol USD 0.34M), with 3.13pp and 0.69pp normalized by the book's sum, which went from 101.85 to 102.25. The distance goes from 15.65pp to 11.80pp, and Ronaldo Caiado rises 2.50pp, to 16.00%. In the five national polls of 30/Sep and 01/Oct third place changes from pollster to pollster: Augusto Cury in Datafolha, with 4%, and in Ideia, with 6.7%; Renan Santos in Real Time Big Data, with 4%; Ronaldo Caiado in Futura, with 4%; and Caiado and Cury tied at 4% in Indexa. 📅 The [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registry lists national releases for Vox Brasil, Datavero and DataTrends on 02/Oct and for eight national polls on 03/Oct, the eve of the first round: Veritá, AtlasIntel, Palver, Datafolha, PoderData, [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest), MDA and Futura/100% Cidades. A registered release is a commitment by the pollster, not a published number.
sentimento.direita: Flávio Bolsonaro at 61.05% in the winner contract (vol USD 12.79M cumulative), up 1.25pp raw and 1.73pp normalized, confirmed reading of 01/Oct, 19:29 BRT. In the points recorded on 01/Oct his price ranged from 61.05% to 63.30%, the high of the series recorded since April 14, and he is 39.05pp from the low, 22.00% on 03/Jul. In the second-place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he falls 5.00pp, to 71.50% (vol USD 1.42M), which means the market pays less for the chance that he finishes the first round in second place. 🗳️ He leads the first round only in Futura, by 42.2% to 39.4%, and the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in Futura, by 49% to 43.5%, and in Real Time Big Data, by 46% to 45%, among the five national polls of 30/Sep and 01/Oct. 📺 He is going to the TV Globo debate of 01/Oct, which Lula announced he will not attend. ⚖️ On the night of 30/Sep the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) full court upheld the removal of the posts that attributed to Flávio Bolsonaro a plan to strip Our Lady of Aparecida of the title of patron saint, and released the post by comedian Antonio Tabet and the cases of reasonable doubt, after André Mendonça adjusted his vote (Gazeta do Povo and G1), and on 01/Oct Flávio Dino declared the case moot and closed his action at the Supreme Court on the matter (Gazeta do Povo and Valor), and Edson Fachin denied Flávio Bolsonaro's request to remove Dino from the cases linked to him, to Lula and to the elections (G1, CartaCapital and Folha de S.Paulo).
sentimento.esquerda: Lula at 37.50% in the winner contract (vol USD 13.00M cumulative), down 2.00pp raw and 1.73pp normalized, confirmed reading of 01/Oct, 19:29 BRT. ⚠️ Not an extreme: he is 30.00pp from the series high, 67.50% on 16/Aug, and 3.00pp from the low, 34.50% on 25/Apr; in the points recorded on 01/Oct he ranged from 36.50% to 38.50%. In the second-place contract of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he rises 4.65pp, to 28.25% (vol USD 1.20M). 🗳️ He leads the first round in four of the five national polls of 30/Sep and 01/Oct, with 42% to 38% in Datafolha and 43% to 39% in Real Time Big Data, and the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in three, with 48% to 45% in Datafolha. 📺 Lula announced he will not attend the TV Globo debate of 01/Oct, and on the afternoon of the same day Justice Estela Aranha, of the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse), issued an injunction barring the broadcaster from showing his empty podium and from directing questions to the absent candidate, and sent the case to the TSE full court (Gazeta do Povo, O Globo and Folha de S.Paulo).
sentimento.terceiraVia: 🥉 Renan Santos stays ahead in the third-place book of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), with 48.50%, and Augusto Cury is at 36.70%, 11.80pp behind; in the series of confirmed readings the distance was 4.15pp with Renan Santos ahead on 26/Sep, 2.90pp and 2.10pp with Augusto Cury ahead on 27 and 28/Sep, 15.65pp with Renan Santos ahead on 29/Sep and now 11.80pp. Ronaldo Caiado rises to 16.00% (vol USD 0.21M) and Romeu Zema is at 0.15%. In the winner book Renan Santos's contract is at 0.25% and remains the one with the highest cumulative volume in the presidential book, USD 15.12M. 📺 Kassio Nunes Marques denied at the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) Renan Santos's request to join the TV Globo debate of 01/Oct, and Cármen Lúcia rejected his action at the Supreme Court (Valor and Folha de S.Paulo).
sentimento.polymarket: Prices from the confirmed reading of 01/Oct, 19:29 BRT (01/Oct, 22:29 UTC), with the presidential book totaling USD 159.29M cumulative across 19 contracts. AFOS only publishes a price that two independent readings, eight minutes apart, confirm within 0.20pp, contract by contract. Volume is cumulative since each contract opened. ⚖️ Alongside the raw move comes the move normalized by the pair's sum, or by the whole book's sum when it has more than two relevant names, because the sum of prices moves on its own. 🗳️ The poll side of the divergence chart uses ONE national poll, not the average: the rule is the most recent one, with ties broken by the largest sample, which gives Datafolha of 01/Oct, n=2,506, and the choice is declared on the chart itself.

inss.text1: ⚖️ ON 25/Sep EDSON FACHIN GAVE THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL'S OFFICE (PGR) FIVE DAYS TO WEIGH IN ON THE PENDING REQUESTS IN THE [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) AND MASTER CASE INVESTIGATIONS, among them requests to review or revoke detentions, as Gazeta do Povo, G1 and Estadão report. The decision settles none of the requests: after the opinion, the case files go back to him. The investigations have been with the presidency of the Supreme Court since 12/Sep.
inss.text2: ⚠️ WHAT SITS OUTSIDE THE GOVERNMENT'S COUNT HAS A FIGURE, AND IT IS STILL THE ONE FROM 03/Sep. Requests delayed beyond 45 days totalled 261 thousand in August, against 1.88 million requests in the full queue. The page keeps the previous figure because there was no new measurement, and it does not estimate.
inss.text3: The definition the government uses, given by the Social Security minister and quoted by Metrópoles on 03/Sep, is that clearing the queue means analysing faster than the legal deadline of 45 days, not having no request under analysis. The two sentences describe different realities, and the distinction belongs to the vocabulary rather than to the measurement.
inss.text4: 📌 ALSO ON 25/Sep, FOLHA DE S.PAULO REPORTS THAT THE DEFENCE OF A FORMER [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) PRESIDENT TURNED TO THE PRESIDENCY OF THE SUPREME COURT against a detention that has lasted more than 300 days; the act has a single source and is included here with attribution. ⚖️ The personal link between the INSS and the Master case recorded on 24/Sep remains the same: the plane Flávio Bolsonaro travelled on in 2025, linked to Daniel Vorcaro and to a lawyer under investigation in the INSS fraud case, and which the senator says belongs to a lawyer friend.
inss.impactoLula: This panel's approval benchmark is [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest), and its 28/Sep round (BR-06520/2026) measures 46% approval against 49% disapproval. ⚠️ The five national polls of 30/Sep and 01/Oct measure government approval from 44.1% to 49%: 44.1% against 52.8% in Futura, 46% against 51% in Indexa, according to CNN Brasil, 46% against 52% in Real Time Big Data, 48% against 49% in Datafolha, according to O Globo, and 49% against 49% in Ideia, according to CNN Brasil. Pollsters ask in different ways, and the panel does not add one to another.
inss.impactoGestao: Within [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) itself the approval and disapproval series is this: 48% against 47% on 05/Aug, 46% against 48% on 14/Aug, 45% against 48% on 02/Sep, 43% against 50% on 07/Sep, 43% against 50% on 14/Sep, 44% against 50% on 21/Sep and 46% against 49% on 28/Sep. That is two waves in a row of rising approval, both within the margin of 2pp. ⭐ The ASSESSMENT benchmark moved little in the same wave: the negative went from 42% to 41%, the positive from 33% to 34% and the fair rating stayed at 23% (O Globo). These are two different questions and they do not add up.
inss.conclusao: On 01/Oct Lula signed a legal opinion that guarantees victims of domestic violence up to six months of leave with pay covered by the [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) (Gazeta do Povo, G1 and Valor). It is a benefit measure, not an act on the queue or on the investigation of the frauds. The five-day deadline that Edson Fachin opened on 25/Sep for the Prosecutor General's Office to give its opinion on the pending requests in the INSS and Master case investigations expired on 30/Sep. In the polls, government approval ranges from 44.1% in Futura to 49% in Ideia among the national polls of 30/Sep and 01/Oct.

bancoMaster.text1: ⚖️ ON 25/Sep THE FEDERAL PROSECUTION SERVICE'S SUPERIOR COUNCIL KEPT THE PROSECUTOR-GENERAL, PAULO GONET, ON THE MASTER CASE PROCEEDINGS AND SHELVED THE REQUEST TO INVESTIGATE HIS CONDUCT. Against his removal the vote was 9-0. On the inquiry, which stood at 4-3 in favour of opening it with two votes still to be cast, the result was 5-4 for shelving, and the last vote was cast by the council's vice-president, Nicolao Dino, who was chairing the session because the proceeding involved Gonet himself (G1, Gazeta do Povo and O Globo). The rapporteur, Francisco Sanseverino, pointed out that the messages from Daniel Vorcaro's phone do not prove direct contact with the prosecutor-general, and the four defeated council members argued for appointing a deputy prosecutor-general to take the inquiry further, according to G1.
bancoMaster.text2: 📸 ESTADÃO, ON 25/Sep, AND VEJA, ON 26/Sep, REPORT THAT DANIEL VORCARO ATTENDED, ON JANUARY 31, 2024, A LUNCH HOSTED BY GRUPO ESFERA IN HONOR OF GONET, in Brasília, with about 40 guests, which Gilmar Mendes also attended. VEJA publishes the banker's message from that day: "I'll be at the Esfera lunch with Gonet. Gilmar should be there". Gonet says he had no friendship with Vorcaro, and the banker's defense says it rejects the selective disclosure of private conversations. 📅 The five-day deadline that Edson Fachin gave on 25/Sep for the Prosecutor General's Office to weigh in on the pending requests in the case, among them those linked to the detentions of Henrique Vorcaro, Felipe Vorcaro, Fabiano Zettel and Daniel Lopes Monteiro, expired on 30/Sep.
bancoMaster.text3: ⚠️ This page's price for the contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving by impeachment before 2027 is from the confirmed reading of 01/Oct, 19:29 BRT, and stands at 2.60%, with vol USD 0.09M cumulative, down 0.30pp against the confirmed reading of 29/Sep. AFOS does not attribute this contract's price to the case's news flow: it measures the two side by side, with each one's timestamps. 🏷️ Still on the agenda, not an accomplished act: the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) scheduled for the week starting 05/Oct the testimonies of André Esteves, Gabriel Galípolo and Roberto Campos Neto on the case, and the expectation recorded by CartaCapital is to hear one per day starting Monday (CartaCapital and Estadão). Daniel Vorcaro's, scheduled for 24/Sep, was postponed at the defense's request, according to Gazeta do Povo.
bancoMaster.conclusao: The case moved on 25/Sep through two procedural acts, not decisions on the merits: the Federal Prosecution Service's Superior Council kept Paulo Gonet on the proceedings by 9-0 and shelved by 5-4 the request to investigate his conduct, and Edson Fachin asked the Office of the Prosecutor-General for an opinion within five days on the pending requests. On 28/Sep, according to G1, Gilmar Mendes adjusted his vote in the ruling on whether Alexandre de Moraes should be investigated, so that it stays suspended until all the judges cited in the investigations are identified; the ruling has been stalled since 15/Sep by Flávio Dino's request for further review. The request to revoke Daniel Vorcaro's detention has been with Fachin since 18/Sep, undecided.

stf.toffoli: He is the justice with the highest rejection in the AtlasIntel poll in partnership with Estadão released on 23/Sep, a survey separate from the electoral one, with 1,852 adults interviewed between 17 and 21/Sep and a 2.0pp margin. On 24/Sep Folha de S.Paulo reports that he voted to remove an opponent of Davi Alcolumbre from the Amapá election and that André Mendonça interrupted the ruling; the act has a single source and is recorded here as attributed. He remains the target of the impeachment request filed by Renan Santos and of the inquiry committee request by Alessandro Vieira.
stf.moraes: The ruling opened on 15/Sep on whether he should be investigated over his relationship with Daniel Vorcaro still has no date, suspended by a request for further review by Flávio Dino. On 28/Sep, according to G1, Gilmar Mendes adjusted his vote in that ruling so that it stays suspended until all the judges cited in the investigations are identified, and proposed internal inquiries; the account comes from a single media group and is included here with attribution. On 25/Sep André Mendonça's filing on the report he used regarding that justice joined the list of pending requests that Edson Fachin sent to the Office of the Prosecutor-General, with a five day deadline. ⚖️ On the same day he was the rapporteur of the criminal case in which the Supreme Court convicted former congressman Eduardo Bolsonaro, 7-3, to one year of detention in an initially open regime for defamation against congresswoman Tabata Amaral.
stf.gilmar: On 28/Sep, according to G1, he adjusted his vote in the ruling on whether Alexandre de Moraes should be investigated, so that it stays suspended until all the judges cited in the Master case investigations are identified, and criticized André Mendonça's handling of the case; the account comes from a single media group and is included here with attribution. ⚖️ On 24/Sep he took to the full bench of the Supreme Court a dispute over power plant court-ordered debts (precatórios) with an estimated impact of R$ 103 billion, after messages from Daniel Vorcaro's phone showed interest in the vote of one justice in that case (O Globo, G1 and Gazeta do Povo). 📸 Estadão and VEJA report that he was at the Grupo Esfera lunch in honour of Paulo Gonet, on 31 January 2024, which Vorcaro attended, and on 26/Sep he publicly defended Gonet after the shelving (O Globo, Valor and Estadão).
stf.dino: ⚖️ On 27/Sep, in a single-justice ruling on a complaint, he overturned André Mendonça's order at the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) that required deleting a post by comedian Antonio Tabet about Our Lady of Aparecida (Jovem Pan and Brasil 247), a decision that Luiz Fux suspended on the night of 28/Sep (G1 and Folha de S.Paulo). After the TSE full court released Tabet's post on 30/Sep, on 01/Oct he declared the case moot and closed the action (Gazeta do Povo and Valor). On the same day Edson Fachin denied Flávio Bolsonaro's request to remove him from the cases linked to the senator, to Lula and to the elections (G1, CartaCapital and Folha de S.Paulo). On 15/Sep he requested more time to review the case in the trial on the investigation of Alexandre de Moraes.
stf.mendonca: His 76-page filing, submitted on 21/Sep, asks Edson Fachin for the summary dismissal of the inquiry against him and for consideration of opening an investigation into Alexandre de Moraes for abuse of authority. On 25/Sep it joined the list of pending requests that Fachin sent to the Prosecutor General's Office, with a five-day deadline. On 24/Sep his office received Flávio Bolsonaro's request to investigate the relationship between Lula and Daniel Vorcaro, and on 25/Sep Folha de S.Paulo reports that he keeps under seal the Master case proceeding in which he denied an operation against Cláudio Castro; the report has a single source and is included with attribution. 🗳️ Also on 25/Sep he ordered social networks to take down more than a thousand posts carrying the false story that Flávio Bolsonaro would strip Our Lady of Aparecida of the title of patron saint of Brazil (Gazeta do Povo, Folha de S.Paulo and CartaCapital), and in the criminal case against Eduardo Bolsonaro he voted for acquittal, outvoted along with Luiz Fux and Nunes Marques. ⚖️ On 30/Sep, at the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) full court, he adjusted his vote to release Antonio Tabet's post and the cases of reasonable doubt, and the court upheld the removal of the posts that attributed to Flávio Bolsonaro the plan to strip the title of patron saint (Gazeta do Povo and G1).
stf.nexo: The link with the election is about the calendar and about institutions, not about the result, and there are two recent measurements of different questions, which do not add up. In the Datafolha poll released on 26/Sep, with fieldwork from 22 to 23/Sep, 33% say the conduct of the Supreme Court justices hurts Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy more and 23% say it hurts Lula's more (G1). In the AtlasIntel poll in partnership with Bloomberg of 23/Sep, 52.3% say the crisis at the Supreme Court hurts Lula's candidacy more and 20.8% say it hurts Flávio Bolsonaro's more. One question is about the conduct of the justices and the other about the crisis, and both pollsters surveyed the same week.
stf.analise: THE CONTRACT ON A SUPREME COURT JUSTICE LEAVING BY IMPEACHMENT BEFORE 2027 STANDS AT 2.60% (vol USD 0.09M cumulative), confirmed reading of 01/Oct, 19:29 BRT, down 0.30pp against the confirmed reading of 29/Sep. It is a thin book, and the price is 23.50pp from the series high, 26.10% on 11/Sep, and 0.50pp from the low, 2.10% on 08/Jun. ⚖️ The case of the posts about Our Lady went through both courts in one week: Mendonça at the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) ordered them removed on 25/Sep, Dino at the Supreme Court released them on 27/Sep, Luiz Fux suspended Dino's decision on 28/Sep, on the night of 30/Sep the TSE full court upheld the removal of the posts that attributed to Flávio Bolsonaro a plan to strip Our Lady of Aparecida of the title of patron saint, and released the post by comedian Antonio Tabet and the cases of reasonable doubt, after André Mendonça adjusted his vote (Gazeta do Povo and G1), and on 01/Oct Flávio Dino declared the case moot and closed his action at the Supreme Court on the matter (Gazeta do Povo and Valor), and Edson Fachin denied Flávio Bolsonaro's request to remove Dino from the cases linked to him, to Lula and to the elections (G1, CartaCapital and Folha de S.Paulo). 📺 Lula announced he will not attend the TV Globo debate of 01/Oct, and on the afternoon of the same day Justice Estela Aranha, of the TSE, issued an injunction barring the broadcaster from showing his empty podium and from directing questions to the absent candidate, and sent the case to the TSE full court (Gazeta do Povo, O Globo and Folha de S.Paulo). ⛔ The panel does not link the contract's price to the day's acts: it measures both with each one's timestamp.
stf.fachin: ⚖️ ON 01/Oct HE DENIED FLÁVIO BOLSONARO'S REQUEST TO REMOVE FLÁVIO DINO FROM THE CASES LINKED TO THE SENATOR, TO LULA AND TO THE ELECTIONS (G1, CartaCapital and Folha de S.Paulo). The five-day deadline he gave on 25/Sep for the Prosecutor General's Office to weigh in on the pending requests in the Master case and [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) investigations, which have been with the presidency of the Supreme Court since 12/Sep, expired on 30/Sep, and only after the opinion will he decide on them. Since 18/Sep he has had on his desk the request to revoke Daniel Vorcaro's pre-trial detention, and on 24/Sep Flávio Bolsonaro's defense asked him to suspend the investigations that reach the senator, as O Globo reports.
